sessions.title: Panel 1: Regulación, medio ambiente y sociedad: Claves para el desarrollo geotérmico sostenible en Latinoamérica.
sessions.details:
The Latin American Geothermal Congress 2025 is set to host a crucial panel discussion titled:

Regulation, Environment, and Society; Keys for Sustainable Geothermal Development in Latin America.

The panel will delve into the multifaceted challenges and opportunities surrounding the development of geothermal energy in the region, focusing on the critical balance between effective regulation, environmental stewardship, and social acceptance.
This session will feature a distinguished group of experts:
Moderator: Barbara Bravo (Chile).

Panelists:
Marlene Jamilet Elias de Quan (LAGEO; SAL)
Wilfredo Flores (CREE; HON)
Augusto Carvalho (SLB; BRA)
Julio Olmedo (FPBH; EC)

The panelists, representing diverse expertise from across Latin America, will share their insights on technical advancements, policy frameworks, and community engagement strategies essential for advancing geothermal projects responsibly. Topics will include navigating regulatory landscapes, mitigating environmental impacts, and fostering strong community relationships to ensure the long-term viability of geothermal energy as a key component of the region’s sustainable energy future.

sessions.title: Panel 2: ¿Cómo incrementar el desarrollo de la geotermia convencional en Latinoamérica sin perder el impulso innovador?
sessions.details:
The Latin American Geothermal Congress 2025 is proud to present a forward-thinking panel discussion titled:

How to Increase Conventional Geothermal Development in Latin America Without Losing the Innovative Momentum?.

This session will explore the critical challenge of scaling up proven geothermal technologies in the region while simultaneously fostering the research and development of new, cutting-edge solutions. The discussion will focus on striking the right balance between rapid deployment of existing methods and investing in the next generation of geothermal innovation to ensure long-term energy security and sustainability.
This panel will feature a distinguished group of experts.

Moderator: Magaly Flores (EPRI-AGM; MEX)

Panelists:
Heber Diez Leon (Trium; MEX)
Andy Blair (Upflow; NZ)
Bryant Jones (GR; USA)
Ella Maria Llanos (ETICA; NZ/COL)
Diego Morata (CEGA; CHI)

The panelists will share their insights on technical advancements, policy frameworks, and financial strategies essential for advancing geothermal projects responsibly. Topics will include navigating regulatory landscapes, attracting investment for both conventional and innovative projects, and fostering international collaboration.

sessions.title: Panel 3: ¿Cómo impulsar la investigación, desarrollo e instalación de sistemas de BCG y el uso directo del calor geotérmico en América Latina?
sessions.details:
The Latin American Geothermal Congress 2025 is excited to host a compelling panel discussion titled:

How to Promote Research, Development, and Installation of GHP and Direct Use Geothermal Heat Systems in Latin America?. This panel will address the critical need to expand the application of geothermal heat pumps (GHP) and other direct-use technologies throughout Latin America. The conversation will focus on overcoming barriers to implementation, promoting new research, and building a sustainable market for these clean and efficient heating and cooling solutions.

The session will feature a distinguished group of experts:
Moderator: Daniela Blessent (AGEOCOL-COL)

Panelists:
Sulamith Kastl (BGR; GER)
Mar Alcaraz (RIGS; ESP)
Jasmin Raymond (INRS; CA)
Suze Guimaraes (UFRRJ; BRA)
Marifour Omarsdottir (GRO-GTP; IS)

The panelists will share their insights on technical challenges, policy support, and economic incentives necessary to advance GHP and direct-use geothermal heat projects in the region. Topics will include case studies from various countries, innovative funding models, and strategies for public education and professional training.

sessions.title:
Working Groups:

Red de Acción Geotérmica (RAG)
sessions.details:
Teams of the Geothermal Action Network (RAG).
The RAG will promote regional technical cooperation.
During the congress, participants will join different working groups. In each group, we will have 90 minutes of discussion, culminating in the drafting of 3 Action Strategies for Latin America. The drafted strategies will be discussed in a plenary session to become part of the final congress declaration.
The goal is ambitious: The teams will meet virtually every 6 months to advance concrete objectives defined during the congress. At the next congress (in 3 years!), the teams will present tangible results of this regional cooperation and propose larger-scale initiatives.

sessions.title:
SEEQUENT Workshop

(Limited seats, under registration only)
sessions.details:
Workshop by SEEQUENT, facilitated by IGA

Integrated Geothermal Modelling - Modern Workflows and Case Studies,

Optimizing a geothermal development requires a robust understanding of the resource throughout its life cycle. Combining insights from geology, geochemistry, geophysics, reservoir and facilities engineering, this workshop provides a step-by-step guide on how to execute a holistic geothermal asset development workflow. This workshop will also focus on how digital technologies can assist in breaking down silos between multi-faceted disciplines, improve collaboration, and positively impact asset generation, and commercial outcomes.
Attendees will learn about the theory behind the technology as well as its direct application. They will also be provided with global examples of where the demonstrated workflows have been applied successfully.
This workshop is proudly supported by the International Geothermal Association (IGA), in partnership with Seequent to advance geothermal knowledge and collaboration.

sessions.title:
AHUACHAPÁN Field Trip

(Limited seats, under registration only).
sessions.details:
Technical visit to the Ahuachapán geothermal power plant on it's 50th anniversary.

Unlock the secrets of resilient and sustainable geothermal energy!
LAGEO is hosting a special guided tour of the Ahuachapán power plant, and you're invited. See the historic first UI turbine and witness the unique craft of candle manufacturing at the AH-8 well. Logistics are still being finalized. Don't miss out, register your interest now to get priority updates and reserve your place!
